inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Repair the lower half of an existing pixel art background of an empty ruined burial grove, keeping its exact palette, light, scale and oblique 2.5D camera. Everything tall stands at the back: the giant dead root tree with its roots ending at its foot, a thin dark seep at the tree's foot, the low walls and ruined stairs. In front of them the courtyard floor is flat, open and empty all the way down: muted worn rounded flagstones exactly like the old Bloodridge court floor, ash and dust in the joints, on the far left turning into dry cracked ash earth. Only flat details: thin cracks, small flat pebbles, a few thin dry roots lying flat. Muted, low contrast, the same values as the rest of the floor. Fine controlled dusty hand-painted pixel clusters like the rest of the image.", "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "The same root tree, low walls, ruins and stairs as the surrounding image, all standing behind one clean line where the flat floor begins.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [390, 29, 911, 763], "desc": "Empty flat courtyard floor of muted rounded flagstones and ash, continuous with the floor around it."}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [330, 250, 400, 560], "desc": "A thin dark seep of water lying only at the foot of the root tree, behind the floor."}]}}
